svg.title: Boot hardening layers
svg.desc: The protections of the hardening note, grouped by its sections: PAC key derivation, PAC, BTI, PAN, closing EL0 exposure, root task integrity and panics, marked as active today, groundwork or not enabled.
svg.text: Boot entropy and PAC key derivation
inputs: DTB rng-seed and kaslr-seed, CNTPCT_EL0, RNDR
SHA-256 in counter mode gives 10 key words
key words wiped from the boot stack
the seed bytes stay in the read-only DTB
Pointer authentication (PAC)
keys loaded, EnIA EnIB EnDA EnDB set in SCTLR_EL1
no instruction uses the keys yet: protects nothing
-Z branch-protection is unstable in Rust
the hardware is ready for the compiler
Branch target identification (BTI)
detected and reported in the boot log
not enabled: the stable compiler emits no landing pads
enabling it now would break the kernel
Privileged access never (PAN)
FEAT_PAN: SCTLR_EL1.SPAN cleared, PSTATE.PAN set
EL1 access through EL0-accessible mappings faults
K0 reaches user frames only through its EL1 alias
real protection today
Closing what EL0 can observe
E0PD1: upper-half access faults without a walk
CNTKCTL_EL1, MDSCR_EL1, PMUSERENR_EL0 reset
CPACR_EL1 = 0: FP/SIMD traps; TPIDR registers zeroed
DEBUG_PUTC: only printable ASCII and newline
Root task integrity
build.rs: ELF checks, no writable and executable segment
SHA-256 of the image baked into read-only data
verify_root_task hashes again at every boot
a corruption check, not an authenticity check
Panics
panic handler: mask interrupts, park the core
release builds print nothing
k0_arch::fatal prints k0: FATAL and halts the core
enter_user masks all exceptions before the restore
Legend
active today
groundwork, protects nothing yet
detected, not enabled
input to the PAC keys
